title: Nigel Farage uses private company to pay less tax on GB News earnings

The Reform UK leader diverts money from his prime-time TV show into his company, which means that he paid only 25% corporation tax on profits, instead of 40% income tax, and could offset some expenses. title: Fears for England riverbank habitats amid relaxed post-Brexit rules
summary: Exclusive: Analysis shows farmers ploughing to the edge of waterways, destroying crucial wildlife ecosystems Huge tracts of precious riverside habitats for water voles and other wildlife in England are being lost as they are not covered by post-Brexit farming rules, campaigners warn. New analysis by the Wildlife Trusts found more than 400 square km of riverside habitat in England may have been lost since the UK left the EU in 2020. Continue reading...
